summary: Costco Wholesale filed a routine Form 8-K on October 14, 2026, reporting an Item 8.01 other event: its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $1.47 per share, payable November 13, 2026, to holders of record at the close of business on October 30, 2026. No advisor, premium, stake, or transaction mechanics were disclosed. The filing also furnished a related press release as Exhibit 99.1. This is an ordinary capital-return announcement, not a special situation, with no risk-arb angle; watch only for future dividend policy changes.
